title: US Delivers First Two F-16V Block 70 Jets to Taiwan
detail: The first two of 65-66 F-16V Block 70 jets ordered under an ~$8 billion deal landed at Chihhang Air Base in Taitung after years of delay. Defense Minister Wellington Koo said more than these two would be delivered by year-end. The US has declined to supply F-22 or F-35 aircraft.

media.caption: F-16V Block 70 landing at Chihhang Air Base, Taitung

title: Taiwan Coast Guard Fires Water Cannons on Chinese Fishing Boats Near Dongsha Islands
detail: Taiwan's Coast Guard fired water cannons on Chinese fishing boats in the disputed Dongsha (Pratas) Island waters, marking a new maritime confrontation as Beijing continues asserting presence in Taiwan-administered waters. The incident highlights ongoing tensions over Taiwan-controlled but disputed maritime territories.

media.caption: Taiwan Coast Guard fires water cannons on Chinese fishing boats near Dongsha (Pratas) Islands
